name: Street Interview
description: One stranger stopped on a pavement and asked a question they answer honestly, with the question itself burned in as the caption. The interviewer never appears. Reads as overheard rather than advertised, which is why it survives a feed that skips anything that opens like an ad.

question.description: The question asked off camera. Short, specific, and awkward enough to be worth answering.

answer.description: The honest answer that lands the brand's point without naming it like an ad.

cta.description: The last line, said by the same person, that names the brand.

presenter.description: Casting note, e.g. 'woman, early 40s, commuter, coat, mid-hurry'.

value.frame: Vertical 9:16 photograph taken on a phone held at arm's length by someone standing in front of the subject, outdoors on a real street. Photorealistic. Overcast daylight, flat and even, no golden hour. Passers-by out of focus behind them, real shopfronts and street furniture, litter and signage. Ordinary outerwear with real creases. Slightly off-centre framing, mild phone-lens distortion, faint motion blur at the edges. The subject is mid-answer, looking slightly off-lens toward the person holding the phone, both eyes open.
value.motion: Keep the exact same person, hair, clothing and street as the reference image. Handheld phone camera, small unsteady drift, occasional refocus. Traffic and pedestrians moving behind them. The person answers a question out loud, gesturing lightly, thinking as they speak.
value.negative: eyes closed, mid-blink, back to camera, sunglasses covering eyes, studio lighting, cinematic colour grade, golden hour, shallow cinema bokeh, airbrushed skin, plastic skin, beauty filter, CGI, 3D render, stock photo, model headshot, polished commercial look, watermark, text overlay, subtitles, extra fingers, warped hands

nodes.system: You direct man-on-the-street interviews for short-form video. The people you cast look like they were genuinely stopped on the way somewhere. Their answers hesitate, correct themselves, and land on something specific. Nobody ever sounds like they are reading a script.

schema.actor: one paragraph pinning down age, build, hair, face, exact outerwear and the specific street
schema.master_frame_prompt: still-image prompt for the establishing frame

shots.frame_prompt: edit instruction from the master frame
shots.motion_prompt: delivery, with the spoken line in quotes

nodes.prompt:
{{shot.frame_prompt}}

Preserve the person's identity, facial structure, hair, outerwear, street and light from the reference image exactly. Change only expression, head angle and framing. Keep the eyes open.
